title: Best Refurbished iPhones Under £300 in the UK (2026)
content_html:
Affiliate disclosure: This article contains affiliate links. If you buy through one of these links, Worth Buying UK may earn a commission at no extra cost to you.

If you want an iPhone without paying new-phone prices, the refurbished market can offer much better value. Below are five models worth checking when your budget is up to £300.

Prices and availability change frequently, so use the links below to check current eBay UK listings before buying.

1. iPhone 14 — best all-round choice

The iPhone 14 is one of the first models we would check with a £300 ceiling. It still offers 5G, a strong camera system and a familiar modern iPhone design, while refurbished prices can be substantially lower than buying a new handset.

Best for: buyers who want a relatively recent iPhone and are happy to spend towards the top of the £300 budget.

Check current refurbished iPhone 14 listings on eBay UK

2. iPhone 13 Pro — best premium option

The iPhone 13 Pro is worth watching if you would rather have a Pro-series handset. Its 120Hz ProMotion display, premium build and more advanced camera system can make it particularly attractive when a good refurbished example falls below £300.

Best for: buyers who value the Pro display and camera features more than having the newest model number.

Check current refurbished iPhone 13 Pro listings on eBay UK

3. iPhone 13 — best balance of price and age

The standard iPhone 13 remains a sensible refurbished buy. It has 5G, strong everyday performance and plenty of choice in the used and refurbished market. For many people it offers the best balance between price, age and capability.

Best for: someone who wants a modern-feeling iPhone while keeping more of the £300 budget in their pocket.

Check current refurbished iPhone 13 listings on eBay UK

4. iPhone 12 Pro — best lower-cost Pro model

The iPhone 12 Pro can be an interesting alternative if you want a premium metal build and triple-camera system but do not need a newer generation. Because it is older, condition and battery health deserve extra attention.

Best for: buyers looking for Pro features at a lower refurbished price.

Check current refurbished iPhone 12 Pro listings on eBay UK

5. iPhone SE (2022) — best budget option

The third-generation iPhone SE is the budget choice on this list. It keeps Touch ID and the traditional Home button while offering newer internal hardware than its appearance suggests. It can also suit someone who specifically wants a smaller, straightforward iPhone.

Best for: first phones, lighter users and anyone who prefers Touch ID.

Check current refurbished iPhone SE 2022 listings on eBay UK

Which one would we choose?

For most buyers, we would start with the iPhone 14 and iPhone 13. Compare the current prices rather than assuming the older handset will always be cheaper. If an iPhone 13 Pro appears within budget from a reputable seller, it can also be a very appealing alternative.

What to check before buying a refurbished iPhone

Do not choose solely on the headline price. Check whether the handset is unlocked, its storage capacity, cosmetic condition, seller feedback, returns policy and warranty. Look for battery information where the seller provides it, and check exactly what accessories are included.

A slightly more expensive phone from an established seller with a clear warranty and returns policy can be better value than the cheapest listing.

What do refurbished condition grades mean?

Terms such as Good, Very Good and Excellent usually describe cosmetic condition, but definitions can differ between sellers. Always read the individual listing rather than relying only on the grade in the title.

Guide updated September 2026. Prices, promotions, availability and condition can change. Always check the current eBay listing before purchasing.
